newsitem.title: FRANCE: UIC proceeds with 805 mln Ffr capital hike.
newsitem.headline: UIC proceeds with 805 mln Ffr capital hike.

text.p: UIC, the property financing arm of state insurer GAN, on Wednesday confirmed it would go ahead with a capital increase to the tune of 805 million francs via an issue of more than 40 million shares at 20 francs each.
UIC chief executive Pierre de Lauzun said on September 17 that a recapitalisation of around 800 million francs would be carried out in the coming weeks.
UIC, which is in the process of a major restructuring, also confirmed in a statement that the capital increase would be subscribed to by parent company GAN.
UIC said it would issue 40,262,244 new shares at 20 francs each to raise 805,244,880 francs and that after the capital increase its net asset value per share would be 9.01 francs.
